commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "07bc0aa1a53a55ff920f1f9ef028c8602fcaa182"
git fetch -q origin agent-control
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
raw = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/20260904-growbox-stage28a-rf433-codec-host-v1.json'], text=True)
task = json.loads(raw)
subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',task['commands'][0]], check=True)
PY
printf '%s\n' '=== protocol 10 spec ==='
grep -n -A8 -B4 '365' src/climate/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.cpp src/climate/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.h || true
printf '%s\n' '=== pulse estimation logic ==='
grep -n -A20 -B10 -E 'estimated_pulse|pulse.*estimate|estimate.*pulse|pulse_us' src/climate/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.cpp src/climate/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.h | head -n 160
printf '%s\n' '=== protocol test around assertion ==='
grep -n -A18 -B12 'estimated_pulse_us' test/test_rf433_protocol/test_main.cpp
printf '%s\n' 'STAGE28A_RF433_PULSE_DIAGNOSTIC_V3_OK'
